items.title: Product Cost Management Lead - AI Infrastructure
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization is building the infrastructure foundation for frontier AI systems. The Supply Chain organization enables scalable, resilient, and efficient supply chains across custom silicon, systems, networking, memory, storage, and rack-scale infrastructure. Our team connects engineering, supplier strategy, manufacturing, planning, deployment, and finance to make hardware cost, supply, and execution tradeoffs clear from early architecture through production and sustaining operations. About the Role OpenAI is seeking a Product Cost Management Lead to own the official costed bill of materials (BOM), system and cluster cost and price baseline, and platform-to-platform total cost of ownership (TCO) for our 1P AI infrastructure. You will turn component, system, POD, manufacturing, deployment, DC, service, and lifecycle inputs into a trusted view of product economics that informs technical and business decisions, including transition timing. You will partner with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, Manufacturing-partner management, Finance, Planning, Supply Chain Program Management, Operations Program Management, and infrastructure teams to evaluate engineering / design changes, compare alternatives, identify cost-reduction opportunities, and track realized benefits. This is an individual contributor role with broad cross-functional ownership. The ideal candidate combines hardware cost expertise, rigorous modeling, sound judgment, and the ability to explain complex tradeoffs clearly to engineering, operations, and senior leaders. In this role, you will: - Own the official costed BOM and system/pod roll-up by platform, generation, configuration, build phase, volume, and mix. Maintain version control and traceability to quotes, source owners, assumptions, and engineering revisions. - Publish and maintain the system/pod cost and price baseline, reconciling component pricing and manufacturing-partner inputs with approved configurations and planning assumptions. - Build platform-to-platform TCO comparisons covering component content, non-recurring engineering, tooling, manufacturing labor and overhead, yield, scrap, test, logistics, deployment, housing and site costs, power and cooling, networking, spares, service, warranty, and lifecycle costs. - Partner with housing and site teams to integrate their cost inputs into product economics, documenting scope, timing, allocation assumptions, and gaps so platform comparisons are consistent and avoid double counting. - Quantify the cost impact of engineering change orders and notices (ECOs/ECNs), architecture, specification, configuration, and qualification changes before approval. Assess recurring and one-time costs, implementation timing, inventory exposure, and expected benefits. - Develop a prioritized cost-reduction, value-engineering, and second-source opportunity funnel with Engineering, Strategic Sourcing, and manufacturing-partner management. Evaluate qualification costs, investment, payback, supply improvements, and execution risk. - Analyze actual, forecast, quoted, committed, and purchase-price costs against the baseline. Explain material variances, identify root causes, and track recovery actions with accountable owners and dates. - Build sensitivity and scenario analyses for supplier and manufacturing-partner options, capacity, volume and mix, yield, configuration, site, deployment timing, and lifecycle tradeoffs. Present clear recommendations with assumptions, confidence ranges, and decision deadlines. - Validate savings and cost avoidance with Finance and accountable source owners. Distinguish identified opportunities, approved actions, and realized benefits, including offsets and implementation costs. - Establish cost-data definitions, BOM hierarchy, allocation methods, currency and volume assumptions, refresh expectations, and change-control processes. Flag stale, incomplete, or unsupported inputs before they affect decisions. - Lead recurring product-cost and TCO reviews. Publish concise cost bridges, opportunity updates, risks, and decision packages while retaining the supporting detail needed for technical and financial review. - Build scalable models, reporting, and data workflows that improve baseline completeness, refresh speed, analysis turnaround, and decision quality as the hardware portfolio grows. - You will own integrated product economics and the cost-analysis methodology and the cost analysis itself. Strategic Sourcing and manufacturing-partner management retain commercial negotiations; Engineering retains design and qualification authority; DC and site teams own their source inputs; Finance retains budgets, accounting, and financial approvals; Planning owns the demand baseline; SCPM owns material readiness; and OPM owns operational execution. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Significant experience in hardware product costing, cost engineering, supply chain finance, manufacturing cost analysis, or a related role supporting complex technology products. - Experience building and maintaining multi-level costed BOMs, system cost roll-ups, and lifecycle or TCO models across product development, production ramp, and sustaining operations. - Strong understanding of hardware cost drivers, including component pricing, manufacturing labor and overhead, NRE, tooling, yield, scrap, test, logistics, and service costs. - Demonstrated ability to evaluate engineering changes, second-source options, and cost-reduction opportunities using comparable scenarios and transparent assumptions. - Advanced spreadsheet and quantitative modeling skills, with disciplined data reconciliation, version control, and source traceability. - Ability to turn incomplete or changing technical and commercial inputs into defensible analysis, identify uncertainty, and drive input gaps to closure. - Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including concise leadership recommendations and detailed working sessions with engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, and finance teams. - High ownership and sound judgment in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements and competing priorities. Preferred Qualifications - Experience with AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, custom silicon, servers, networking, storage, or rack-scale systems. - Experience analyzing JDM, CM, or ODM cost structures and open-book manufacturing models. - Familiarity with DC and site economics, power and cooling, deployment timing, spares, and service costs in infrastructure TCO. - Experience with ERP, MRP, and PLM systems, BOM change control, and business intelligence or automation/AI tools. - A background in engineering, finance, supply chain, manufacturing, or a related analytical discipline. What Success Looks Like - Teams use a complete, current, and traceable costed BOM and system/pod baseline as the source of truth for product economics. - Platform TCO comparisons use consistent scope and assumptions, with inputs validated by their owners. - Material engineering and sourcing decisions include timely cost-impact analysis and explicit tradeoffs. - Cost variances have clear explanations, accountable owners, and recovery actions; savings and cost avoidance are validated. - Leadership receives clear recommendations, and cost-management processes scale with the complexity of the 1P hardware roadmap. items.title: Security Data Engineer
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run. You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. The goal is security that runs itself: custody, access and evidence verified continuously from records, with tools and AI agents doing the reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's compute and data center operations teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers. The role is based in San Francisco, with remote applicants in the US considered, and involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure. Key responsibilities Hardware inventory and chain of custody: own the component-level record of what hardware exists, where it is and who has handled it: the data model, the pipelines that join inventory and custody events from many source systems, change history on every record, and the tamper-evident stores behind it Tools, automation and AI agents: build the tools and agents the team runs on this data: reconciliation, audit evidence exports, custody checks. When a review keeps costing people time, you build the tool or agent that retires it Custody workflows and field software: build the workflows and the site and host software that capture custody events as they happen (a receipt, a move, a data wipe, a decommission) and enforce who is authorized to record them Continuous control monitoring and posture: own the pipelines that turn check outcomes, assessment results and findings into per-control and per-site measures over time, against the compliance frameworks we and our partners are assessed against, and the posture calculation that decides what a site is cleared to run Data quality: build coverage checks, reconciliation against sources and alerts on a silent or drifting feed, so a wrong or missing record is caught the same day; own retention and access controls on the records Integration and reporting: agree schemas and interfaces with the engineers who run the security monitoring platform, and build the query surfaces and reports the team, site leads and leadership use directly Minimum qualifications Have designed and run production data systems (relational schemas, change data capture, batch or streaming pipelines and the services around them) and kept them correct: coverage measured, records reconciled against the source, alerts on silence, and a design that expects records to get corrupted or lost Have integrated with systems you did not control (inventory tools, ticketing systems, vendor APIs) and built data models that outlive any one source Have shipped software that runs outside a central service (host agents, site-local services, edge collectors) and kept it correct in the field, or built metrics a team made decisions on and defended them when challenged Have worked hands-on with data about physical assets or security controls: a hardware fleet, data center or supply chain inventory, asset custody, or the control and evidence data of a security or compliance program Read and review other people's code, and build with AI coding agents using Git and code review Own a domain end to end: set the approach, design and build it with the teams and vendors whose systems it depends on, and run it as something people use every day Write SQL and at least one general-purpose programming language well Preferred qualifications Experience with asset management, supply chain or warehouse systems where serialized tracking and custody transfer are the core problem Experience building continuous control monitoring or metrics for a security or compliance program, or producing evidence an assessor accepted, for example against NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 Experience with risk or posture scoring that combines control results, findings and other evidence into a measure people make decisions on Familiarity with data center hardware and its lifecycle from receipt to decommission, and with sites and parties you did not control: colocation, cloud or GPU cloud operators, hardware manufacturers, logistics providers Have run software on many hosts or at remote sites with versioned rollout and a way to know each copy is still reporting Have built AI agents or automation that replaced recurring manual work The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Trading Specialist
items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Denver, CO; Lake Mary, FL; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Trading Operations team is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant trade execution across all supported asset classes while protecting customers and the firm. The team partners closely with Engineering, Compliance, Customer Experience, and external market centers to maintain system stability and trading integrity during all market sessions. Robinhood has now introduced 24/7 trading and this hire will help support this new function. As a Trading Specialist, you will monitor live trading activity across overnight, extended hours, and regular market sessions while supporting the health of Robinhood’s trading infrastructure. You’ll investigate and resolve trading issues, coordinate responses to system or venue disruptions, and communicate clearly with internal teams and external partners. This role offers hands-on exposure to trading operations, risk management, and customer-impacting decisions, with meaningful opportunities for learning and career growth! This role is remote but will be tied to a local Robinhood office in New York, NY, Lake Mary, FL, Chicago, IL, or Denver, CO. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. Shifts Available: Work Schedule 1 (all times are EST): Tuesday 11:30AM - 8:30PM Thursday 11:30AM - 8:30PM Saturday 9AM - 9PM Sunday 9AM - 9PM Work Schedule 2 (all times are EST): Friday 9pm - Sat 9am (Friday overnight to Saturday) Sat 9pm - Sun 9am (Saturday overnight to Sunday) Sunday 8pm - Mon 5am (Sunday overnight to Monday) Wednesday 8pm - Thurs 5am (Wednesday overnight to Thursday) What you’ll do Execution of Written Supervisory Procedures to comply with all SEC and FINRA rules Order entry and trade execution of equity and option orders Resolution of trade inquiries Monitor trading activity, firm accounts, corporate actions, and identify and resolve problems associated with trades Monitor health of routing systems and Venues, and interact with Venues as required Coordinate response for system, trading, and communications (SEV) related issues. Engage with cross functional teams (Product, Engineering, Compliance) on product development and problem solving. What you bring Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience 3-5 years working in a broker-dealer operations/trading environment FINRA Series 7 required FINRA 57 license required Strong understanding of brokerage operation functions Self-starter with ability to work independently Strong communication and analytical skills Ability to effectively prioritize and adapt to a changing environment What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $115,000 — $135,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $101,000 — $119,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $89,000 — $105,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

We’re exploring how frontier AI can help people design, simulate, and build better physical products—shortening development cycles, improving product performance, and expanding what engineering teams can accomplish. Our initial focus is on mechanical and electrical engineering. We’re building experiences within ChatGPT and integrations with engineering software to help engineers move from early concepts through design, simulation, and preparation for production. We operate as a small founding team within OpenAI, working directly with customers and closely with research, design, and forward deployed engineers. We learn by building, putting products in users’ hands, and using their feedback to guide our next steps. You’ll work across frontend experiences, backend services, and integrations to bring AI into complex engineering workflows. You’ll combine strong software engineering fundamentals with product judgment and an eye for intuitive user experiences. Working directly with engineers and design partners, you’ll identify valuable problems, prototype solutions, and develop them into reliable products. We’re particularly interested in engineers who have built CAD, CAE, simulation, or other engineering design software. You should be comfortable owning work independently, making decisions with incomplete information, and moving between product details and system architecture. items.title: Site Reliability Engineer
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role We are seeking highly experienced Site Reliability Engineers (SRE) to shape the reliability, scalability and performance of our platform and customer facing applications. You will work closely with our software engineers and research teams to ensure our systems meet and exceed our internal and external customers' expectations. What You Will Do As a Site Reliability Engineer, you balance the day-to-day operations on production systems with long-term software engineering improvements to reduce operational toil and foster the reliability, availability, and performance of these systems. items.description: About the Team The Value Engineer team helps customers turn frontier AI into real business value. We accelerate adoption of OpenAI technology at scale and guide organizations from initial activation to measurable, organization-wide impact. We partner closely with Sales, Product, Solutions Architecture, and Security to deliver safe and responsible AI transformation. Our work shapes how customers generate and measure tangible outcomes from OpenAI products and creates a repeatable blueprint for successful enterprise launches and expansions. About the Role We are hiring a Value Engineer to help articulate and quantify the business value of OpenAI’s technology across Enterprise, Education, and Government customers. In this role, you will help customers and internal teams translate AI adoption into measurable financial and operational impact. As an early member of the Value Engineering team, you will help define how OpenAI measures and communicates the real-world impact of AI across its customers. You will partner closely with Sales, AI Success Engineers, AI Deployment Engineering, and Product teams to identify high-impact AI use cases and build financial and operational business cases. Your work will directly influence executive alignment, investment decisions, renewals, and long-term expansion. You will play a key role in helping build and shape the value engineering function from the ground up — developing repeatable frameworks, ROI models, value narratives, dashboards, and collateral that help internal teams and customers understand and measure the impact of AI adoption. Success in this role is measured by how clearly customers and internal teams can quantify the value of AI, how effectively business cases support adoption and expansion, and how scalable value frameworks become across the GTM organization. This role is based in San Francisco or New York City and we offer relocation benefits to new employees. In This Role, You Will - Lead business value assessments for our largest deals, working closely with customers to identify key business drivers and quantify the value of OpenAI’s products to support investment decisions - Build and maintain standardized ROI, TCO, and value modeling tools for internal and customer use. - Lead structured value discovery to identify high-impact use cases and define measurable outcomes. - Publish executive-ready business cases that quantify results and strengthen relationships with C-level stakeholders. - Codify value frameworks, methodologies, and reusable assets that scale value-based selling across the global GTM organization. - Establish baselines, KPIs, and dashboards to track and communicate value delivery. - Partner closely with Account Directors and post-sale teams to influence deal strategy, renewals, and expansion opportunities. - Contribute to thought leadership on AI-driven business transformation by identifying emerging patterns in how organizations realize value from AI. You Will Thrive in This Role If You - Bring 6–10 years of experience in value engineering, management consulting, or adjacent roles. - Have strong financial and analytical skills, with experience quantifying and presenting value to executive stakeholders. - Demonstrate exceptional executive presence with strong written, verbal, and presentation skills. - Have experience working on large-scale AI, cloud, or digital transformation initiatives. - Communicate with clarity and confidence across technical and business audiences. - Can translate AI capabilities into compelling financial, productivity, and workforce transformation narratives. - Enjoy managing multiple complex customers and driving toward concrete, measurable outcomes. - Demonstrate humility, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset. - Operate with high ownership, urgency, and comfort navigating ambiguity. - Are a creative builder who thrives in 0→1 environments and enjoys rolling up your sleeves to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Senior Social Media Manager
items.location_text: Mountain View, CA; San Francisco, CA
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role Glean is looking for a Senior Social Media Manager to own and grow our organic social presence across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. You'll be the voice behind Glean's brand channels and a key partner to our executives and technical leaders, turning product launches, company moments, and market conversations into content that educates, celebrates, and inspires the use of Work AI. This is a hands-on role for someone who moves fluidly between real-time execution (live-posting a launch event) and longer-range program building (scaling an employee advocacy program, standing up a technical social-listening motion). You'll report to the Director of Communications and work closely with Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, PR, Sales, and R&D to make sure Glean shows up consistently and credibly everywhere our audience is paying attention. You Will: Own Glean's always-on content calendar and organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, aligned to our content pillars: educate, celebrate, and inspire the use of Glean's Work AI platform. Create and edit lightweight, platform-native multimedia content - including short-form video, clips, graphics, and other social-first assets - using tools such as Capcut, Canva, or other. Manage executive social media presence for Glean's CEO and other company spokespeople — ghostwriting, scheduling, and coordinating posts that tie technical and company narratives to the broader Work AI story. Lead live social coverage for major company moments, including product launches, Monthly Drops, and flagship events (e.g., Glean:GO), publishing and amplifying content in real time across channels. Own and scale Glean's employee advocacy program (currently run via Oktopost) — onboarding and training advocates, curating ready-to-share content, managing the licensing/vendor relationship and renewals, and reporting on reach, engagement, and pipeline attribution (in partnership with Sales/SFDC). Build and run a technical social-listening and rapid-response motion (e.g., a "Glean Gurus"-style program) with R&D and PMM, surfacing and engaging in relevant conversations on X, Reddit, and other technical forums. Partner with Sales and Sales Enablement to train employees on social best practices and personal branding, and run onboarding sessions on how to engage safely and effectively on behalf of the brand. Manage relationships with outside agencies or contractors supporting content production, cross-posting, and coverage during high-volume periods. Track and report on social performance (reach, engagement, follower growth, and pipeline/revenue influence) and translate insights into content and channel strategy recommendations. Monitor brand sentiment and competitive conversation, applying sound judgment on when and how to engage, and act as a first line of defense on social-related reputational risk. Collaborate cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Content & Thought Leadership, and R&D to ensure social amplifies — and helps shape — the broader company narrative. About You: 6+ years of experience managing organic social media for a B2B or enterprise technology/SaaS brand, ideally with direct ownership of a corporate LinkedIn and X presence. Experience managing or ghostwriting for executive social accounts, with strong instincts for voice, tone, and what's appropriate to post on a leader's behalf. Experience running or scaling an employee advocacy or social amplification program (e.g., Oktopost, EveryoneSocial, GaggleAMP) with measurable results. Comfort operating in real time — live-posting events, responding quickly to trending conversations, and making fast, sound judgment calls under time pressure. Strong writing skills and an editorial eye, with the ability to translate technical or dense product content into clear, platform-native copy. A data-driven approach to social, with experience using analytics tools to measure performance and tie social activity to pipeline or business outcomes. Experience partnering cross-functionally with Communications, PR, Product Marketing, Sales, and Engineering/R&D stakeholders. Strong technical fluency, with the ability to quickly understand complex AI, product, and engineering concepts and translate them into accurate, accessible, and compelling social content. Vendor and budget management experience (agencies, social tooling contracts) is a plus. Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View or San Francisco office). Availability for occasional evening/early-morning coverage around major launches and events. Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $172,000 - $198,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-HYBRID AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, but you will be expected to travel to project sites regularly, aligned with project requirements. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Lead full lifecycle execution of a range of infrastructure and facilities build-out projects simultaneously, including advanced compute facilities, labs, testing environments, and production spaces. - Own detailed project estimating, budgeting, and financial analysis to ensure fiscal responsibility and efficiency. This includes securing capital funding - Engage, contract and drive external partners (architects, contractors, construction managers and other consultants) to deliver mission-critical projects on accelerated timelines - Collaborate closely on projects with internal teams like Real Estate, Operations, Corporate Security, IT/AV, EH&S, stakeholder team and Finance - Partner closely with Leasing on site selection, providing due diligence and cost forecasting to support site acquisition - Own the relationship with internal clients and executives, driving engagement, alignment, and decision-making. - Develop and oversee technical due diligence efforts for each project, which may include technical assessments, AHJ coordination, utility requirements and feasibility studies. - Develop and review concept designs, which will define programming that is aligned with all stakeholders and guide design development. - Review and contribute to design drawings, mechanical and electrical layouts, utility diagrams, specifications, and technical documentation. items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. Senior Product Manager, Money Movement Experiences Menlo Park, CA Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Money Movement team builds the products that let customers move money and assets into, out of, and within Robinhood. Our work spans the infrastructure and partner integrations underneath and the experiences customers see on top, and we partner closely with design, data science, compliance, and fraud. Moving money is where customers decide whether they trust a product, and we want it to feel as good as investing. We care a lot about removing friction. A transfer should be fast and easy to follow, with the kind of polish customers notice. Everything else customers do at Robinhood starts here, so we want it to be something they enjoy. As a Senior Product Manager on the customer experience side of Money Movement, you will set the vision for how moving money feels and deliver experiences customers find clear and delightful. You will lead zero-to-one launches, own the end-to-end journey across mobile and web, and sweat the details, from the copy and motion to the states in between. You will partner with design, engineering, legal, and operations to ensure what we ship is compliant and a pleasure to use. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you'll do Define the long-term product vision and roadmap for Robinhood's money movement customer experience, spanning funding, deposits, withdrawals, and transfers Lead zero-to-one product initiatives that make moving money faster and more delightful, from first concept through launch Partner closely with design to shape the work, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft and interaction detail Drive significant improvements in funnel conversion, transaction success, and customer satisfaction by finding friction and failure points in the journey and using research, experimentation, and analytics to prioritize Partner with engineering and the platform teams that own our payment rails and vendor integrations to turn platform capabilities into reliable, fast customer-facing experiences Work with compliance, legal, and fraud teams to ensure every experience meets regulatory requirements without compromising the customer experience What you bring Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent experience 5+ years of experience in a product management role, with a proven track record of shipping consumer products that customers love, ideally mobile-first A history of close collaboration with design: you partner with designers from concept to launch, give and receive sharp critique, and hold a high bar for craft Exceptional attention to detail and strong product taste, with examples of experiences you shaped where polish made a measurable difference Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated consumer space is a plus; you do not need to be a payments expert, and you will learn the rest quickly High technical empathy and experience partnering closely with engineering to resolve complex tradeoffs and deliver clean user experiences Familiarity using user research, experimentation, and product analytics to guide decision making Demonstrated ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, formulate opinionated product recommendations, and drive alignment across senior stakeholders A strong sense of urgency and speed, high standards, and a strong work ethic: you always bring your best and expect your colleagues to do the same Clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with design, engineering, operations, and external partners What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet: a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. items.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - AI Infra - SF
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development. About the role Forward Deployed Engineers lead complex deployments of frontier models in production. You will embed with customers where model performance matters, delivery is urgent, and ambiguity is the default. You will use this to map their problems, structure delivery, and ship fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer for AI Infra, you will work directly with customer engineers, researchers and product engineers on optimization problems across semiconductors and AI infrastructure. You will write and debug software, run experiments against real workloads and hardware, and improve the tools and product used across engagements. You will help define the problem and success criteria, build the software needed to test an approach, and stay with the work through validation and deployment. Work may include inference performance and chip-design optimization. Success means producing results that stand up to correctness and performance checks, and contributing improvements that other engagements can use. Success in this role means owning the delivery state across workstreams. You will hold the bar on quality and pace and help OpenAI learn through execution. This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role, you will: - Own technical delivery for agreed semiconductor and AI-infrastructure workstreams, from initial scoping and prototypes through validation, production deployment and adoption. - Work closely with customer engineers to understand their workflows and constraints, define workloads, baselines and success criteria, and help what you build become part of how they work. - Scope and sequence delivery, identify dependencies and blockers early, and make practical trade-offs between scope, speed and quality as the work develops. - Personally build and debug production-quality software, including harnesses, integrations and product features that apply frontier models to problems in chip design, verification, inference and performance engineering. - Design reproducible experiments, evaluations, graders and benchmarks to test approaches, validate correctness and performance, and establish whether improvements hold up in real engineering environments. - Investigate model behavior and failure modes alongside researchers, contributing evaluation or training data and targeted experiments where they can improve the underlying capability. - Contribute directly to core product development, working with product engineers to resolve tooling gaps, ship useful improvements and bring field learning into product decisions. - Lead technical discussions and maintain alignment across customer, Product and Research teams. Build the domain and product fluency to explain capabilities, limitations and results, and keep ownership, risks and next steps clear. - Turn successful approaches into reusable software, tools and playbooks, reducing the effort needed for future engagements and helping customer teams operate what has been built. items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Polymarket is looking for a Senior Web Engineer to own complex frontend features, improve reliability, and help us ship faster with confidence. You'll own major web surfaces end-to-end: from scoping and implementation through launch, monitoring, and production support. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of frontend product development, backend systems, performance, and reliability. You should have experience in crypto and be comfortable shipping complicated React/Next.js features, debugging ambiguous production issues, and working across teams without needing hand-holding. We want someone who can move fast, make strong technical decisions, and help raise the quality bar for our frontend systems. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own and ship complex features end-to-end. Build and launch web features across Polymarket's core product surfaces, making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, quality, architecture, and long-term maintainability. - Collaborate across the stack. Work closely with backend engineers to design APIs, reason through data flows, and build reliable user experiences on top of complex systems. Partner with QA, TPM, product, and design to clarify requirements, manage launches, and improve product quality. - Own reliability and incident response for your domain. Monitor dashboards, alerts, and user reports to identify and respond to issues quickly. Work with backend and infrastructure teams during incidents to isolate root causes, ship mitigations, and follow through with fixes and prevention work. - Improve frontend observability. Build and improve the logs, metrics, alerts, dashboards, and error reporting that give the team visibility into how our frontend systems are performing. - Raise the engineering bar. Identify meaningful technical debt, propose pragmatic refactors, and contribute to system design discussions that evolve our frontend architecture as the product scales. Lead by example through strong code reviews, clear communication, and high-quality execution. - Tie technical work to outcomes. Connect your work to measurable results – performance, reliability, product quality, and conversion – and help break down ambiguous product requirements into shippable engineering work. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of frontend web engineering experience with experience in crypto, Web3, or adjacent financial infrastructure - Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend development - Strong frontend system design instincts across state management, data fetching, caching, performance, reliability, and maintainability - Experience owning complex features from scoping through launch - Strong debugging skills and experience responding to production issues - Comfortable working with backend engineers on APIs, data contracts, failure modes, and system behavior - High agency: you notice problems, propose solutions, and drive work to completion - Product-minded: you care about user experience, not just implementation - Able to operate independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment - Clear communicator during planning, launches, bugs, and incidents - (Plus) Frontend performance specialization - (Plus) Experience with high-traffic, real-time, marketplace, trading, or financial products - (Plus) Experience building for WebViews or shared web/mobile surfaces - (Plus) Experience improving frontend observability, alerting, or reliability practices - (Plus) Strong practical use of AI tools to improve engineering productivity BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $230,000 to $330,000 annually, plus equity and benefits. This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

This is a high-bar role requiring extreme ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate complex hiring challenges in a fully remote, high-agency, async-first environment where speed and quality are the standard. Main differentiators between this role and any other Sourcer role on the market: - Managing uncertainty: Payward is at the forefront of the innovation spectrum. As such, you can expect to tackle roles that you have never heard about, with no prior experience, data or track record - Subject matter expertise: We are building one interoperable stack connecting crypto, tokenized assets, and traditional markets. We are looking for experts in the fintech field, or deep thinkers able to bridge that gap quickly - Pace: You will be expected to flex your sourcing skills across Tech, Non-tech and anything in between with a very quick turnaround, across different payzones and businesses under the Payward umbrella, including Kraken, Ninjatrader and Reap. - Builder mentality: We are not looking for a plain executioner but someone that will contribute to building something new, awesome and cutting edge - Team work: Our sourcing team’s track record is unprecedented - we provide velocity and quality to our pipelines through hard work, but always working as a team. We have no room for solo players or internal competition In return, we offer the chance to leave a mark in one of the most innovative companies in the space as well as the opportunity to join a world-class and high-performance team. If you believe you have what it takes, continue reading below. THE OPPORTUNITY - Partner with Hiring Managers and Recruiters to design and execute effective hiring strategies - Gather, organise and communicate competitive market intelligence, identifying where target talent exists and sharing industry trends - Collaborate with the broader sourcing team in leveraging best practices across research techniques, boolean searches, tools, networking and other sourcing methods - Independently develop and maintain candidate flow across a variety of disciplines, leveraging data to drive decision making and process improvement - Source candidates through a variety of search resources (social media, internal database, job boards, networking, internet searches, etc.) - Be an ambassador to Kraken/Payward, sharing our values and drive brand awareness in the market - Participate in research projects and other initiatives which improve the infrastructure of hiring WHAT YOU BRING - Exceptional track record sourcing talent for reputable, fast-growing, high bar technology/product businesses against ruthless competition. Bonus points if you’ve hacked it in crypto, fintech or any product-driven org - High craft - Ability to translate hiring needs into accurate sourcing strategies; strong expertise in boolean/X-ray sourcing - High motor - Scrappiness - you do not see problems but opportunities - Strong product sense - Sound appreciation for the fundamentals of talent acquisition, but creative and inquisitive when considering modern tactics - High agency, strong bias for action, and the confidence to push boundaries, influence stakeholders, and close exceptional talent without compromise. - Comfort in the chaos, thriving in ambiguity, owning your outcomes, and moving with urgency in a fully async, remote-native setting - Ability to produce compelling market intelligence based on business and industry knowledge - Fintech/crypto understanding required. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. items.title: Game Operations Analyst, Sports (Remote - Estonia, Service Provider)
items.description: By bringing together next-gen technology and the finest live data available, Genius Sports is enabling a new era of sports for fans worldwide, delivering experiences that are more immersive, interactive and personalised than ever before. Learn more at geniussports.com. We’re upfront about where we use AI in our hiring process. Our guidelines cover our approach to the use of AI, as well as what you can expect during the interview process. Read our full guidelines here . THE ROLE: Join the Genius team behind GeniusIQ, our live game tracking technology, and help build a brand-new Game Operations team in Estonia. You’ll help ensure our tracking and event data is accurate and on time, supporting the Game Operations team and leading a group of Operators during live football and basketball games. A fully remote hourly paid Service Provider position in Game Operations is a great fit if you: Want a flexible side hustle alongside your studies or main job Love sports and want to get your foot in the door of sports tech Are happy with routine tasks and enjoy being part of the live action WHAT YOU’LL DO: Set up and configure GeniusIQ software for live games Confirm correct tracking of dead balls, stoppage time and similar events Identify and confirm teams, lineups and players Stay alert during live play and report issues to your mentor Complete marking tasks that improve the accuracy of our system Lead a group of Operators on 1-2 football games per task Lead training for newly signed Operators WHAT YOU’LL BRING: Your own setup: a personal laptop or computer (not too old) with at least 512GB storage, and an internet connection of at least 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload Around 40-80 hours of tasks per month on average, mostly evenings, weekends and holiday periods , with fewer tasks in the summer (following the sports schedule). General computer literacy, particularly Excel or Google Sheets Football knowledge (any additional sport is a bonus) High attention to detail and the ability to focus in loud, distracting environments Extreme punctuality, as many tasks start near game start time Excellent communication skills, especially under pressure, to update your mentor and give feedback to Operators Ability to make time-sensitive judgment calls and collaborate with remote colleagues during live events As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports. One team, being brave, driving change We strive to create an inclusive working environment, where everyone feels a sense of belonging and the ability to make a difference. Learn more about our values and culture at Culture | Genius Sports. Let us know when you apply if you need any assistance during the recruiting process due to a disability.

items.title: DevSecOps Engineer
items.description: We are looking for a hands-on DevSecOps Engineer to join a fast-growing software development company delivering fintech and iGaming products. In this role, you will take ownership of security across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and development processes, helping build secure and scalable products. Responsibilities: - Drive the evolution of the company’s DevSecOps function by defining security initiatives, long-term priorities, and promoting a security-first engineering mindset - Partner with the DevOps team to improve the security and resilience of Kubernetes (EKS), Istio, Service Mesh, and related cloud-native infrastructure - Support engineering teams during service transitions by embedding security best practices into operational processes and ensuring effective knowledge sharing - Develop and maintain policy-as-code frameworks and infrastructure validation mechanisms using technologies such as OPA and other compliance automation tools - Improve the security of infrastructure provisioning and deployment workflows across Terraform, Ansible, and other Infrastructure-as-Code solutions - Integrate, maintain, and optimise security testing and scanning capabilities throughout the software development and release lifecycle - Build automation around security monitoring, compliance checks, and operational controls to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort Requirements: - Strong practical understanding of modern DevOps principles and secure CI/CD pipeline design - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes or other enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms - Proven experience working with Infrastructure-as-Code and configuration management technologies such as Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or equivalent tools - Solid background in administering production infrastructure, including web servers, databases, and supporting services - Good understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing principles, and the OSI model - Experience securing distributed systems and microservices-based architectures - Proficiency with Git or other source code version control platforms - Practical experience securing cloud environments, preferably AWS, though experience with GCP or other major cloud providers is also valuable - Ability to assess infrastructure security posture, identify vulnerabilities, and implement appropriate remediation measures - Experience implementing identity and access management controls together with security automation practices - Hands-on knowledge of secrets management platforms (such as Vault) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions - Experience integrating SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning, or similar security tooling into CI/CD workflows - Good understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) principles and familiarity with security maturity frameworks such as OWASP SAMM v2 - English level: Upper-intermediate or higher What’s in it for you: - Fully remote working format - Competitive salary based on experience - Paid annual leave and sick leave - Opportunities for professional and career growth - Supportive environment focused on continuous development and long-term growth

items.title: Casino Specialist
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Casino Specialist to join our team in Malta. Reporting directly to the Casino Manager, you will sit at the intersection of product operations, commercial strategy, and provider management. In this role, you will take full ownership of day-to-day operations across assigned markets and brands. Your focus will be keeping our lobbies fresh and commercially optimized, coordinating game releases, troubleshooting operational issues, and partnering with game providers to secure promotional budgets and exclusive games. This is an ideal position for someone with solid gaming product experience who enjoys autonomy, works well under pressure, and wants to make an immediate impact on our core casino performance. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Managing daily casino operations across assigned markets, ensuring seamless game launches and optimal lobby positioning. - Building strong relationships with game providers to negotiate marketing co-funding, promotional campaigns, and exclusive releases. - Monitoring product performance metrics and delivering clear, actionable presentations to commercial cluster teams. - Acting as the main point of escalation for operational bugs, digging into root causes, and resolving issues directly with providers. - Collaborating closely with Marketing, Delivery, and Compliance teams to launch new initiatives smoothly and compliantly. - Representing LeoVegas Group at industry conferences and evening partner networking events. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - 1–2+ years of hands-on experience in iGaming product operations, casino coordination, or gaming delivery. - Strong commercial understanding of casino games, lobby management, and promotional mechanics. - Practical experience tracking product KPIs, analyzing performance data, and presenting insights to internal stakeholders. - Excellent organizational skills with the confidence to prioritize tasks, set clear boundaries, and solve problems independently. - Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills, with a genuine interest in building external provider relationships. NICE TO HAVES - Hands-on experience with front-end CMS tools (such as Redstone) or casino back-office platforms. - Existing network across top game suppliers, or experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g. Claude) to optimize daily workflows. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid work policy - 4 weeks of Workation (T&C apply) - Well-being allowance to support your active lifestyle - Private health insurance - Discounts across a range of retailers, gyms, bars & restaurants - We offer an employee assistance program that can provide help and guidance during challenging moments. JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Senior Backend .NET Software Engineer - Payments
items.description: About the Role Are you an experienced Senior Backend Software Engineer ready for your next challenge? The Payments Engineering Area is hiring! Payments Engineering is responsible for building the best payment customer experience from payment pages perspective and improving the offering of different payment options across global brands and markets that we operate within. We are an international team with some of the best people in the industry! If you are passionate about the latest technologies and can handle company-critical responsibilities, then this is the role for you! What You’ll Work On Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable server-side applications using the .NET framework and related technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, product managers, and designers, to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. Develop and implement efficient and secure RESTful APIs and microservices to support client applications and integrations. Perform thorough testing and debugging of backend applications to ensure high quality and reliability. Optimise application performance and scalability through code optimisations, caching strategies, and database optimisations. Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to architectural guidelines, and best practices. What You Bring Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS). Strong background in backend development, with experience in languages such as C#/.Net Knowledge of NoSQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server databases. Experience in design and implementation of distributed systems that comprise of multiple domain-oriented services. Understanding of front-end development technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Familiarity with version control systems, preferably Git. Familiarity with containerisation technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns. Proficiency in SQL databases both in writing queries and optimising performance Effective communication skills in English, both verbal and written, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in backend development and actively contribute to improving development processes and efficiency. Nice to Have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. We don’t expect you to be an expert in all these technologies but would anticipate experience with some combined with a curiosity for others: etcd, Consul, Redis, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, gRPC, Orleans. Benefits Hybrid working model Private health insurance Life insurance Wellness allowance Home office set-up allowance 24 days annual holiday leave + additional days for public holidays falling on weekends Flexible compensation benefits Remote working from abroad options Who We Are Betsson Group is one of the largest companies within the Global iGaming space and can trace our heritage as far back as the 1960’s. We’re Swedish and publicly listed too with our Operational HQ located on the Mediterranean Island of Malta. We strive to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. As a market leader within iGaming we offer online gaming products across 12+ jurisdictions and 20+ brands. You will be part of a passionate team, which is building an industry leading, scalable, multi-brand platform used by hundreds of thousands of our customers! Product Development at Betsson Group Our Product Development organisation is truly Global with cross functional teams spanning 6 Tech Hubs – Malta, Budapest, Stockholm, Tallinn, Malaga and Athens. With around 1,000 strong professionals, the Product Development organisation is spear-headed by our CTO-CPO with all our talented Area Teams working together. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your next step, please submit your CV in English. By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy
