items.title: Junior VIP Host - English Speaking
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Junior VIP Host to build meaningful relationships and deliver personalised service to Stake’s most valued players at Easygo a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and live-streaming platforms. You’ll become a trusted point of contact for your own portfolio of VIP players, working closely with our wider VIP team to ensure every player feels valued, supported, and engaged. What you'll build with us: We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity based in Melbourne, with a unique split-shift structure combining time in our office with remote evening work to support our global VIP community. . You’ll manage a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players , building lasting relationships through proactive communication, personalised rewards, and tailored experiences. Alongside resolving customer enquiries, you’ll develop a deep understanding of Stake’s products and player behaviours, helping us continually elevate the VIP experience. Who is Easygo? We're a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We're building the future of fearless tech. We're the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that's where the real fun happens. We're always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you'll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can't get anywhere else. Please note that in this role our team works 6 days a week for 6 hours a day. Your hours and location of work are below: Mon - Friday - 9am - 2pm (Office) Mon - Friday - 9pm - 11pm (Home) Saturday Or Sunday: 9am - 2pm + 9pm - 11pm (Home) The impact you’ll make: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with a dedicated portfolio of approximately 350 VIP players, delivering personalised service that makes every interaction count. Act as the primary point of contact for your VIP players, understanding their individual preferences, needs and behaviours to deliver exceptional customer experiences. Proactively engage with players to build rapport, strengthen relationships and encourage long-term loyalty. Manage player enquiries from start to finish, ensuring timely responses, effective problem-solving and positive outcomes. Deliver tailored rewards, bonuses and cashback offers in line with established processes and player needs. Use communication platforms including live chat, email and Telegram to maintain meaningful and consistent engagement with VIP players. Monitor player activity, behaviours and trends, using insights to identify opportunities to improve the overall VIP experience. Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex enquiries, escalate concerns and ensure a seamless player experience. Work closely with VIP Managers, Supervisors and Senior Hosts to achieve team KPIs and continuously improve service standards. Your track record: Minimum 1 year's experience in a customer service environment, ideally within hospitality, sales, account management or a similar customer-facing role. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build genuine relationships and adapt your approach to different personalities. A customer-first mindset with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional, personalised service. Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, particularly when managing challenging customer interactions. Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously. A proactive, solutions-focused approach with the ability to take ownership of customer enquiries and follow through to resolution. Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn new systems, products and processes. Comfortable working towards KPIs and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team. Confidence using digital communication platforms and customer management systems. Bonus points if you also have: Previous experience within the wagering, iGaming or online casino industry. Knowledge of cryptocurrency, sports betting or casino products. Experience managing customer portfolios, VIP relationships or customer retention. Familiarity with Google Workspace, Slack, Jira or Intercom. Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Applied AI Architect, OpenAI for Government
items.description: About the Team The OpenAI for Government AI Architect team partners with public sector organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with government agencies, public institutions, and partner organizations serving the government to identify where AI can advance critical missions, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, Security, Global Affairs, and specialist delivery teams to help public sector customers adopt advanced AI responsibly and effectively. About the Role As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will shape each customer's AI strategy and guide their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable mission impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate mission priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value. The Account Director leads the overall account strategy and relationship, while you lead the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production impact. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong public sector fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. This role is based in Munich or London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of public sector customers and pre-sales prospects. - Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities. - Lead discovery with agency leaders, mission owners, executives, and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful mission and operational outcomes. - Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, identity, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment. - Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, building confidence in both the solution and its path to production. - Help customers navigate the security, compliance, governance, and deployment requirements that shape AI adoption in the public sector. - Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans. - Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Chief Data and AI Officers, program leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders. - Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, security, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams. - Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged. - Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable mission impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization. - Apply public sector and mission expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities. - Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success. - Have guided complex organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable impact. - Have experience working with government agencies, public institutions, or government contractors and understand how mission priorities, security, compliance, governance, and procurement considerations shape technology adoption. - Build credibility with senior technical and government leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers and program teams. - Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy. - Understand modern AI systems, frontier models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, and enterprise AI workflows. - Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript. - Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to establish clear handoffs and ownership. - Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes. - Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant public sector mission or customer segment. - Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan. - Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping public sector organizations deploy advanced AI safely and responsibly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. items.title: Identity Engineer
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? The Identity Engineer will help build - not just run - a new identity platform that every person, system and AI agent at Easygo authenticates through. What you’ll build with us: It’s a greenfield project: standing up a modern cloud identity platform, and operationalising it. The foundation is only the start and we have so much more to build on top of that ncluding identity and security for agentic AI. Alongside delivery, you'll be the identity subject-matter expert — partnering with engineering and product teams so they can build fast without having to worry about identity, making secure authentication and authorisation the easy path. Success requires strong hands-on identity engineering skill with an AI first mindset, a collaborative and proactive way of thinking, clear communication, and the ability to balance reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement in a fast-moving environment. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Build and run the workforce identity platform, and integrate Easygo’s applications, services and AI agents with it, from sign-on and MFA to provisioning and service-to-service authentication. Build identity for AI agents: every agent has an accountable identity with scoped, delegated access, so we always know who it is, who it acts for and what it can do. Automate the identity lifecycle so access follows HR data and policy. Manage identity as code and automate manual work, using AI coding agents as part of how you build and run the platform. Use risk signals and identity threat detection to stop risky sign-ins and respond automatically. Build an AI-native identity operation. Use agents to automate onboarding, access requests and lifecycle tasks, with humans approving high-impact actions. Support identity governance and privileged access as they mature, and extend them to non-human and agent identities. Your track record: Essential Strong software or platform engineering background. You write production-quality code (e.g. Python, TypeScript or Go) and work with REST APIs, Git and CI/CD every day. Strong demonstration of AI-first engineering: AI coding agents are part of how you build, and you use agentic workflows to run operations, such as automating routine tasks, triaging issues and drafting fixes, with the right guardrails and human review. Deep, practical understanding of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM: what goes in a token and why, how each flow works, and how each one gets attacked. Hands-on experience engineering a modern workforce identity platform, including at least one identity migration. PingOne (including DaVinci) experience is a strong plus. Manages configuration as code with Terraform, pull requests and automated pipelines. Bonus points if you also have: Understands identity and security for AI agents: agent identity, delegated (on-behalf-of) access, scoped short-lived credentials, MCP authorisation and prompt-injection risks. items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. About the Role We’re looking for a Procurement Operations Manager to support subcontracting and intercompany purchasing and payment coordination for a growing deployment business. You will keep agreements, staffing changes and purchase order (PO) funding aligned, and own the research, supplier communication and follow-through needed to resolve issues. Accounts Payable (AP) handles invoice processing and payments; Accounting owns accounting decisions. You will also manage subcontracting workflows in our deployment operations platform and use OpenAI technology to automate repeatable steps. This combines hands-on operations with building and testing practical AI workflows that improve speed, accuracy and service as the business grows. Location: San Francisco, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the office (Monday–Wednesday). In this role, you will: - Coordinate subcontracting and purchasing from intake through completion: prepare agreement and amendment inputs, track reviews and signatures, and execute approved PO requests and changes. - Translate staffing, scope, term and engagement-value changes into coordinated updates to agreements, PO funding and billing schedules. Keep the source documents and transaction records connected. - Lead research and supplier issue remediation across contracts, POs, invoices and payments. Identify the cause, secure corrections, keep suppliers informed and give AP complete supporting evidence. Follow each issue through resolution. - Serve as the primary contact for intercompany invoice and payment status. Follow up with approvers, investigate stalled handoffs, and coordinate procurement and ERP system issues with AP, Accounting and Finance Systems through resolution. Keep stakeholders informed of progress and next steps. - Own subcontracting workflow requirements for the deployment operations platform. Build practical AI support for intake, extracting terms, preparing drafts, comparing records and researching exceptions. Test outputs against current sources and validate calculations. - Partner with Procurement Enablement and Finance Systems to improve workflows and integrations. Measure cycle time, rework, issue aging and time saved, then use the results to prioritize improvements. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring hands-on experience in procurement, procure-to-pay, finance operations or a related field, with a record of independently following work through to completion. - Understand how agreements, approvals, PO funding, invoices and payments connect. You can investigate discrepancies, explain findings to suppliers and coordinate a supported resolution with AP and Accounting. - Bring practical AI fluency and experience improving workflows with automation. You can show what you built, how you validated results and what improved. - Work confidently with spreadsheets and procurement or ERP systems, investigate transaction and workflow issues, and coordinate fixes with system owners. - Build trust through responsive service, careful listening and proactive communication with employees, suppliers and stakeholders. Exercise sound judgment with incomplete information and urgent requests, and follow through to resolution. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our production services. You’ll contribute technical expertise to system and architectural decisions and partner with engineers across the organization to deliver dependable systems. Glean’s rapid growth brings complex distributed-systems challenges across a hybrid cloud environment. You’ll use your software engineering and SRE skills to automate repetitive work, build tools, and improve deployment, monitoring, and on-call workflows. From investigating incidents and reducing toil to optimizing performance, capacity, and cost, your work will help Glean scale while providing customers with a reliable experience. Influence best practices, drive cross-team collaborations, and contribute to the execution of key objectives in alignment with engineering leadership and cross-functional partners. Establish strong technical credibility, shaping architectural decisions and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable systems. Ensure High Availability: Implement and maintain resilient cloud architectures, monitor system performance, and proactively identify and resolve potential bottlenecks or points of failure. Incident Management: Participate in primary oncall rotation; cultivate technical curiosity and growth mindset, and a blameless postmortem culture within the team. Continuously optimize the on-call process for sustainability and efficiency. Automation and Tooling: Develop and maintain automation scripts, tools, and processes to streamline system deployment, monitoring, and management tasks. Your contributions will be vital in efficiently scaling cloud operations. Performance Optimization: Optimize cloud infrastructure and applications for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. Security and Compliance: Collaborate with security engineers to implement best practices and ensure compliance with security standards and policies. Monitoring and Alerting: Design and configure advanced monitoring systems to gain insights into system behavior, set up alerts, and respond proactively to potential issues. Create and maintain comprehensive dashboards and playbooks for production on-call. Software Development Consultation: Engage actively in the entire software development lifecycle. Participate in system design reviews and provide valuable SRE insights during launch reviews, influencing and enhancing system architecture. About you: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in a senior-level role within Site Reliability Engineering or similar role, particularly in managing cloud-based services and infrastructure. 5+ years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages. 3+ years of experience leading projects and designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems running in Cloud. Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure. Practical experience with containerization technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools like Terraform is essential. Solid understanding of networking, security principles, and best SRE and security practices. Proficiency in using monitoring and alerting tools to detect and respond to potential issues effectively Location: This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View Office) Compensation & Benefits: The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $260,000 annually. items.title: Solutions Engineer, LATAM
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Solutions Engineer to help enterprise customers across Latin America turn complex information and AI challenges into practical business outcomes. You will partner with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design through tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, and purchase decisions. This is not a demo-only role: you will help customers validate the right use cases and create a credible path from technical evidence to a business decision. You will: Lead technical discovery with enterprise customers, uncovering business goals, workflows, technical requirements, stakeholders, decision criteria, and risks. Design and deliver tailored demonstrations, architecture workshops, and customer presentations that connect Glean’s capabilities to specific customer outcomes. Lead technical evaluations and proofs of value with agreed scope, measurable success criteria, clear customer responsibilities, and decision gates. Explain enterprise AI, search, and SaaS architecture—including integrations, data flows, identity and permissions, security, and operational tradeoffs—to technical and business audiences. Help customers evaluate build-versus-buy choices by surfacing lifecycle effort, security, maintenance, and ownership considerations without relying on FUD. Build value cases for strategic opportunities, including customer-specific ROI and procurement-ready business rationale. Partner closely with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, map stakeholders, align on meeting objectives, and create clear next steps while maintaining distinct AE and SE ownership. Multi-thread technical and executive relationships and help maintain momentum when stakeholders or evaluation requirements change. Bring customer insights, product gaps, and competitive patterns back to Product, Engineering, and the broader Solutions Engineering team. Create reusable regional demos, technical guidance, and field learnings that help the team execute consistently. About you: Approximately 3+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, technical pre-sales, solution architecture, technical consulting, or comparable customer-facing technical work in enterprise SaaS. Strong technical discovery and solution-design skills, with the ability to ask precise questions, make assumptions explicit, and explain integration, identity, security, and architecture tradeoffs. Experience delivering customer-specific demonstrations, workshops, or technical evaluations and adapting your explanation for both engineers and executives. The judgment to define a useful proof of value: why it is needed, what it will prove, how success will be measured, and what decision follows. The ability to translate technical fit into business value, including the confidence to recommend a narrower evaluation—or no evaluation—when that best serves the customer. Experience working with technical buyers and partnering with Sales and cross-functional teams through complex customer decisions. Fluent Spanish and Portuguese for customer-facing conversations and materials across the role’s regional coverage, and professional English for internal collaboration. Curiosity and learning agility in enterprise AI, search, and modern SaaS platforms, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly without overstating what a product does. Clear written communication, dependable follow-through, and a collaborative approach to working across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups. Experience with enterprise AI, search, knowledge management, data platforms, developer tools, enterprise integrations, APIs, cloud platforms, identity and access management, security reviews, competitive evaluations, ROI models, technical business cases, reusable demos, or regional enablement materials is helpful but not required. Location: This role is remote and must be based in Latin America. São Paulo or Mexico City is preferred; remote candidates elsewhere in LATAM may be considered based on role coverage and local hiring feasibility. Compensation & Benefits: Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to our 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. #LI-REMOTE AI-First Mindset at Glean: At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. items.description: About the Team The Strategic Finance team provides financial insights and guidance to support the organization's long-term goals and strategies. We partner across the business to allocate and deploy our resources for the highest impact outcomes. About the Role We are hiring a Strategic Finance Generalist to help drive strategic decisions for OpenAI across a variety of areas, including but not limited to: strategic and commercial transactions, capital markets activities, and partnering with Research, Data, and Corporate Development teams on critical initiatives. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Support strategic project work spanning transactions, capital markets activities, market research, new business model evaluations, and other business critical initiatives. - Provide occasional finance business partnership to Research, supporting financial planning, program funding, and other business needs. - Create high-quality presentations for communicating OpenAI’s financial performance. - Distill our business and cost drivers into key metrics that underpin how we communicate financial performance, allocate resources, and plan for growth. - Identify areas of opportunity across our P&L, cash flow and balance sheet. - Stay current on market trends and best-in-class financial performance benchmarks. - Working closely with our Accounting and Corporate Finance teams to build and evolve our financial reporting as well as finance team operations. You might thrive in this role if you have: - 8+ years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or buy-side investing, coupled with strategy and operations, business operations, or strategic finance experience at a fast-paced tech company. - A strong ability to critically evaluate opportunities and risks in financials. - The ability to distill complex financial data into actionable insights and effectively communicate with leadership. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex analyses and influence decisions across functions. - Strong ownership, attention to detail, and the energy to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. - Familiarity with business models and metrics relevant to OpenAI. - Enthusiasm for technology and artificial intelligence. - Extensively used AI. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Public Sector Delivery Analyst
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ROLE OVERVIEW: We're growing our Canadian Public Sector Delivery team and hiring Public Sector Delivery Analysts to help run some of the most consequential AI deployments in the country. You'll work alongside our Engineering Program Managers (EPMs), Technical Leads, and senior leadership to keep large, multi-stakeholder government programs organized, documented, and moving. This is a hands-on delivery role for individuals who want exposure to enterprise AI and high-stakes program delivery while taking pride in making complex programs run smoothly. As a member of our small, senior team, you'll deliver sovereign AI to the Government of Canada, engage directly with clients from day one on a clear path toward leading engagements, and learn how frontier AI products are deployed in real, high-security environments. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Drive things to closure. Partner with the EPM and Technical Leads to track actions, dependencies, and blockers across Cohere and client teams making sure nothing slips. - Show up in front of the client. Prepare and coordinate client sessions, capture outcomes, and progressively lead working-level sessions such as use-case and story refinement. - Run the cadence. Own the meeting and reporting rhythm including agendas, scheduling, minutes, and follow-ups so every forum lands on time with clear next steps. - Own the delivery artefacts. Build and maintain the plans, status reports, RAID logs, decision records, use-case registers, and traceability documentation that keep our engagements audit-ready and our clients confident. - Keep the record straight. Maintain a single source of truth for program documentation in our public sector document management environment. QUALIFICATIONS: - 1–4 years of experience in technology or management consulting, professional services, or an in-house technical delivery team. - Delivery discipline. You've run RAID, action, and decision logs, refined user stories, maintained project plans on real projects and kept them accurate and clear. - Client presence. You can lead a working session in front of a client, read the room, and know what to say and what to hold. - Strong written communication. You think through the message before you build the slide. Advanced PowerPoint, Word, and Excel. - Technical fluency. You're comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, environments, testing, and releases. You can talk with engineers and report back accurately. - Follow-through. You close items without a second reminder and know what to escalate and when. - Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance. - Based in the Ottawa area. - University Degree in Business/Commerce, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or similar preferred. - Nice-to-have: High degree of French language proficiency. WORKING LOCATION: This role is hybrid with the requirement to be based out of Ottawa - note, there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. This role requires eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance and a high degree of French language proficiency is a nice-to-have. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Compensation Lead
items.description: We're hiring a Compensation Lead to build Perplexity's compensation function and own its day-to-day execution. You'll build the programs and processes that support how we hire, recognize, and retain people. You should be comfortable moving between program design and an individual offer, building longer-term structure while keeping today's decisions moving. The goal is a compensation approach that is competitive, financially sound, and clear enough for people to use, without adding unnecessary complexity. WHAT YOU'LL OWN - Build the compensation foundation. Assess existing practices, data, and tools; prioritize the gaps; and develop recommendations on compensation philosophy, market positioning, and cash and equity guidelines. - Develop salary ranges and market benchmarks. Establish a consistent approach to pricing roles across functions and locations. Partner with People and business leaders on job scope and leveling, and explain where market data is useful or incomplete. - Own day-to-day compensation decisions. Be the primary partner for offers, promotions, pay adjustments, and compensation questions. Evaluate recommendations against market data, internal equity, and budget, with clear approval paths for exceptions. - Design and run compensation reviews. Build the calendar, planning models, manager guidance, and approval process. Coordinate with Finance, People Operations, Payroll, and equity partners to carry decisions through to accurate implementation. - Inform leadership decisions. Model the cost and employee impact of proposed changes to salary and equity programs. Present a recommendation and its trade-offs, then own execution once approved. - Identify and address inconsistencies. Assess pay compression and potential inequities across teams, levels, and locations. Partner with People leadership and Legal on appropriate reviews and recommend actions. - Build processes people can use. Establish decision records, recruiter and manager guidance, and clear explanations of compensation programs. Improve recurring workflows so consistent decisions don't depend on individual knowledge or one-off conversations. - Own the data and tools behind the work. Establish reliable compensation records, select and manage benchmarking resources, and improve reporting and quality checks. Use approved automation and AI tools where they help, with appropriate protection for employee information and verification of results. WHAT YOU BRING - Experience building compensation programs: You've established or substantially rebuilt compensation frameworks and processes with limited infrastructure, and stayed accountable for running them after launch. - Technical compensation depth: Hands-on experience with market pricing, salary ranges, cash and equity programs, compensation reviews, and individual pay recommendations. - Strong analytical judgment: You can build and audit models, reconcile imperfect data, and explain your assumptions. You know when a benchmark is a useful comparison and when it misses the role. - Ability to influence decisions: You can turn analysis into a clear recommendation, discuss trade-offs with leadership, and constructively challenge an approach that isn't working. - Independent, hands-on execution: You can set priorities, build a workable process, and manage urgent requests without losing progress on longer-term work. You're comfortable being both the person designing the program and the person checking the data. - Discretion and clear communication: You handle sensitive information carefully and explain compensation decisions in language that recruiters, managers, and employees can understand.

items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? In this role, you will manage the team that owns the Cohere inference APIs and SDKs, as well as the Cohere Dashboard, where customers can access our models, manage teams, and audit billing. You will collaborate with internal partners to craft a delightful, intuitive, and unified experience across everything the Cohere APIs and Cohere Dashboard have to offer. As a hands-on leader, you will shift seamlessly between roles as mentor, strategist, and technologist to guide the team toward shared success. Join our team of builders who are shaping the future of large language models! AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER OF THE COHERE APIS AND DEVEX TEAM, YOU WILL: - Manage, mentor, and grow a talented and enthusiastic team of backend and full-stack software engineers - Participate in model releases and develop new API capabilities - Work closely with Modelling and Model Serving teams - Collaborate with UX designers to ensure customers have an easy and delightful time managing teams, API keys, billing and configurations. - Oversee and contribute to open source projects YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You have experience managing engineering teams and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software - You have experience shipping products with a large number of stakeholders - You’re comfortable with the front and back end of the stack, and have previously worked with Go, Next.js, TypeScript, and React - You are passionate about recruiting and growing people and teams - You are passionate about building rapport with your team and you prioritize 1:1s - You have excellent communication skills and believe that documentation is a great way to get feedback and discuss technical implementations and designs - You have the ability to take complex needs and goals and develop easy to understand explanations for all audiences - You’re excited about AI and have the motivation to scale a company FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective
items.description: About the Collective The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor , you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes. What You’ll Do Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry. Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development. Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field. Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft. Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work. Who Should Apply We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule. Why Join Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models. Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives. Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing. Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview. Application Process Apply: Share your background and a link to your portfolio. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Portfolio Review: Share one past project you’re proud of. Nothing is used without a signed agreement and payment, and we’ll follow up with next steps. Meet the Team: A paid conversation with our research and ML team to walk through your work. Get Started: Successful candidates are invited to join the Human Frontier Collective as a Creative Advisor. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.title: Legal Response Specialist
items.location_text: San Francisco, Washington D.C., New York City
items.description: We're hiring a Legal Response Specialist on Perplexity's Support team to handle legal and other sensitive tickets. You'll help Legal answer routine requests for information and support Governance, Risk & Compliance, or GRC, on privacy and security requests. You'll review cases, write responses, and follow up until the work is done. Support Engineering owns the routing and safeguards that keep these tickets from being missed, answered by AI, or automatically closed. RESPONSIBILITIES - Monitor designated Support and Legal channels, assess urgency, and route requests for human review. Promptly escalate government, court, law enforcement, and legal-threat requests according to approved procedures. - Respond to routine requests using Legal-approved templates and guidance. Escalate matters requiring legal interpretation or disclosure of user information. - Answer routine requests for information under Legal's guidance. Gather account history and draft responses for matters that need review. - Help GRC process data subject requests and meet deadlines. Follow approved identity-verification and data-handling procedures. - Coordinate security questionnaires and data protection agreements, with Legal and GRC responsible for substantive review and approval. - Track each case through completion, including after handoffs. Record decisions, follow up on deadlines, and confirm the work is done before closing. - Work with Support Engineering to test routing, AI bypass rules, auto-close protections, and alerts. Investigate missed cases and verify fixes. - Keep approved replies and handoff instructions current with Legal and GRC. Arrange backup coverage so cases keep moving when you're out. - Handle other sensitive support escalations. Report backlog, response times, overdue cases, and recurring problems to Support, Legal, and GRC. REQUIREMENTS - 5+ years in support, trust and safety, legal or privacy operations, or compliance, ideally at a technology company. - Experience handling legal, privacy, or law enforcement requests. - Working knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, and data subject requests. - Judgment about when to involve Legal or GRC, and care with confidential and privileged information. - Clear writing, including in sensitive customer conversations. - Ability to manage competing deadlines and follow through without reminders. - Experience improving support processes with technical teams, including automation and AI safeguards. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with Intercom, Decagon, Linear, or Kodex. - Paralegal, privacy, or compliance experience or certification. - Experience with security questionnaires, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA. - Familiarity with AI products or data tools for case reviews.

items.title: Engineering Technician, Actuators
items.description: About the Team Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives. About the Role We are seeking Engineering Technicians to support the assembly, testing, and prototyping of custom electromechanical actuators for advanced robotic systems. You will build and test hardware from engineering drawings and procedures through inspection, troubleshooting, and rework, partnering closely with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers. These roles focus on hands-on work with precision electromechanical hardware, including stator prototypes, motor and actuator assemblies, and mechanical and electrical testing. You will help turn engineering designs into validated hardware while improving build records, work instructions, and repeatable assembly and test practices for future robotic platforms. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 5 days a week. In this role, you will: Each opening focuses on actuator builds, testing, or stator prototyping, with responsibilities aligned to the selected specialty. - Actuator builds: assemble subassemblies and complete actuators from drawings, bills of materials, and work instructions, checking fit, orientation, torque, routing, and workmanship. - Testing: set up and run established mechanical and electrical tests, confirm the setup against the procedure, record measurements, and identify unexpected results. - Stator prototyping: support winding, insulation, termination, bonding, inspection, and rework using the selected build process and documented instructions. - Troubleshoot build and test issues with engineers. Isolate problems through inspection and measurement, escalate deviations, and verify the result after approved rework. - Maintain accurate build and test records, part and revision traceability, inspection results, and rework history. - Use bench observations to improve work instructions, fixtures, tooling, and parts organization as prototypes evolve. - Follow safety, ESD, cleanliness, and quality practices, and communicate material shortages, unclear instructions, and other blockers as priorities change. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have hands-on experience building or testing mechanical, electrical, or electromechanical hardware in a lab, prototype shop, or manufacturing environment. - Can work from drawings, bills of materials, wiring diagrams, and procedures, and recognize when the instructions and hardware do not agree. - Use hand tools, torque tools, and measurement equipment carefully, with consistent workmanship and attention to units and acceptance limits. - Troubleshoot methodically, document observations, and know when to pause work and ask for engineering support. - Take ownership of build quality and records while adapting to changing designs and priorities. Preferred Qualifications Experience relevant to the selected specialty may include: - Building or testing actuators, motors, robotics hardware, servos, or other precision electromechanical systems. - Motor manufacturing, especially stator assembly, winding, insulation, termination, bonding, impregnation, or inspection. - Soldering, crimping, connector assembly, harness routing, adhesives, or fixture-assisted assembly. - Mechanical or electrical test setup, instrument checks, measurement capture, and documenting unexpected results. - Inspection, traceability, nonconformance handling, and structured rework. - Hands-on rework, basic machining, or prototype part modification using shop tools. - Use of calipers, micrometers, multimeters, LCR meters, insulation-resistance testers, or torque tools. - Improving prototype or manufacturing work instructions and build processes. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. items.title: Trust and Safety Program Manager
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized “house,” Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future. We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire. ABOUT THE ROLE Trust & Safety protects the platform, keeps our users safe and builds trust with the people we depend on for our growth. This role straddles between program management of Polymarket US, a CFTC-regulated exchange, and on the Polymarket DeFi platform. Every product Polymarket ships reaches traders in a regulated market, so each launch, each user protection and each response to an incident has to hold up with users, regulators and the public. As the function's first Program Manager, reporting to the Global Head of Trust & Safety, you will own those programs end to end: launch readiness for new products, markets and jurisdictions; the controls and evidence behind Polymarket's regulatory commitments; user protections such as self-exclusion, deposit limits and behavioral monitoring; and incident response. You will set how each program runs, partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal and Compliance, and report to leadership what each program delivers. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own launch readiness for new products, markets and jurisdictions on the exchange and on DeFi: tier every launch, run the go or no-go, and secure written sign-off from Legal, Compliance and Trust & Safety before each major launch - Turn regulatory obligations and commitments into controls, procedures and evidence, and keep the record ready for any regulator inquiry or exam - Bring risk review and user protection requirements into each launch from the first spec, including what the launch can and cannot claim publicly - Launch and monitor user protections such as self-exclusion, deposit limits, behavioral monitoring and trusted-contact tools, and drive them from scoping to adoption - Run DeFi restriction programs, including self-certification and close-only, from flag to enforcement - Lead the program side of Trust & Safety incidents, and build and drill the crisis playbook with Compliance, Customer Experience, Legal and Communications - Take partners and vendors from pilot to contract, with a success measure agreed before each pilot starts - Own the metrics and the cadence: quarterly goals, the weekly Trust & Safety update and business reviews - Build and run Trust & Safety's intake process for partner teams WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 6+ years in program or technical program management, including 3+ in trust and safety, risk, integrity, responsible gaming, fraud or compliance at a regulated platform - You have run a launch risk-review process that product teams used, and can name launches it stopped or changed - You have led or run the program side of a live incident with user harm or regulatory exposure - You have prepared evidence for a regulator, auditor or exam, and turned a regulatory obligation into a control or procedure - You have built a program at a company that had none - You have taken a vendor or partner from pilot to contract - You pull and reconcile your own data (SQL or equivalent) - You write short, dated decision documents with an owner on every line - You are comfortable as the only program person in the function (Plus) CFTC, NFA or exchange experience (Plus) Responsible gaming programs or player protection (Plus) Crypto, DeFi or onchain compliance BENEFITS - Competitive salary & equity - Unlimited PTO - Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage - 401k match - Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $165,000 to $190,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

items.title: Data Center Operations Engineer
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We are looking for a Data Centre Operations Engineer to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Centre Operations is a ‘hands-on’ role that is critical to the continuing success of Kraken; you will join a highly motivated team that is responsible for managing the entire network and compute infrastructure for one of the world’s leading Cryptocurrency exchanges. We are looking for a dynamic and innovative self-starter with the ability to think “outside of the box” to solve complex problems in a sustainable way. items.title: Legal Counsel - US
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY As Legal Counsel, you’ll be an early member of the Mistral legal team in the US, which forms part of the global legal team. The core of this role is (a) drafting and negotiating commercial agreements to support the growth of our business in North America and (b) supporting the development of AI tools to scale Mistral’s legal operations. As part of a start-up legal team, you’ll need to be nimble enough to quickly ramp up on new areas of law, such as product matters (privacy, marketing, and regulatory compliance), intellectual property, and other matters, as needed. You should be comfortable with charting new paths and interested in designing the legal department of the future. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts across the business, including customer MSAs and order forms and partnership agreements. - Collaborate with a cross-functional group of Mistral’s technical (including engineering, applied AI, and science), business, and legal teams. - Improve and develop tools to facilitate and automate legal workflows and approval processes, compliance with and creation of company policies, and internal training materials and guides. - Refine and create templates to scale with the company as it grows. - Provide solution-oriented legal, regulatory, and strategic advice and direction to teams across our company, from the initial stages of project development to launch and beyond. - Efficiently manage and work with outside counsel to support projects you manage. - Stay up-to-date and ensure compliance with U.S. and international laws and regulations that apply to AI technologies, including AI-specific regulations, privacy and data protection, competition, consumer protection, payments, and intellectual property. - Build positive relationships across the company and with its external partners. - Occasional travel to Paris headquarters is encouraged. WHO YOU ARE - JD from an accredited law school and member in good standing of a U.S. state bar. - 4+ years of law firm and/or in-house experience, including experience in project management. In-house experience at a technology company and/or in a fast-paced and high-growth environment is a strong plus. - Experience managing technology implementation/solutions projects to meet corporate operational standards. - Experience drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, including creating and refining form agreements. - Fluency in common AI tools, and a track record of responsibly using AI technologies to drive efficiency and process improvement. - Generalist skill set with the willingness to tackle problems outside your core expertise. - Ability to balance an attention to detail with the requirements of a fast-paced company. - Demonstrated business and pragmatic judgment, and the ability to analyze the costs/benefits of proposed resolutions to complex legal and technical problems. - Proven ability to build solid, trusting, and credible relationships, including working closely with science, engineering, business, and marketing teams. - Excellent writing, communication, and people skills. - An understanding of AI technologies and their applications, including how they intersect with relevant areas of law, such as privacy and data protection, competition, and intellectual property, and related ethical considerations such as fairness, transparency, accountability, and bias mitigation - An international mindset and experience is a plus. - Given the rapidly evolving nature of AI technologies and the legal landscape surrounding them, you should be adaptable and willing to continuously learn and update your skills and knowledge. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
